periods.time: One week after Ikki vs Toka

name.zh: 破军代表任命与一辉任团长
name.en: Hagun Representative Appointment and Ikki's Captaincy

periods.summary: After Ikki sleeps for a week, the scandal quiets due to the Vermillion king's displeasure toward the Ethics Committee and media. Kurono appoints Hagun's six representatives and names Ikki team captain; Toka personally hands him the school flag and asks him to carry the defeated fighters' wishes to the Seven Stars summit.
periods.cause: The selection battles are complete and the school must formally appoint the representatives.
periods.process: Stella, Botan Hagure, Kanata, Kikyo Hagure, Nagi and Ikki are named. Kurono explains Ikki is captain because he defeated multiple representative candidates. Toka gives him the flag she had expected to carry herself.
periods.outcome: Ikki accepts the burden of others' expectations and receives public cheers as the Uncrowned Sword King.
periods.significance: Closes the school selection arc and transitions the story to the national Seven Stars stage.
